Shortbread Saucers

Served at: Polaris Meteor Watch & UFO Evening

Makes about 24 shortbread saucersPrep 15 minCook 20 min

Shortbread Saucers are buttery, crisp cookies shaped like small flying saucers, perfect for the whimsical Polaris Meteor Watch & UFO Evening. These treats add a playful touch to the stargazing event, evoking the theme of UFOs with their distinctive round shape and delicate texture.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar
  • 2 cups (240 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Extra granulated sugar for sprinkling

Method

  1. Preheat the oven to 325°F (163°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
  3. Mix in the vanilla extract.
  4. Gradually add the flour and salt, mixing until the dough just comes together.
  5. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to about 1/4 inch (6 mm) thickness.
  6. Use a small round cookie cutter (about 2 inches/5 cm diameter) to cut out saucer shapes.
  7. Place the cutouts on the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 1 inch (2.5 cm) apart.
  8. Sprinkle a little granulated sugar on top of each saucer for a subtle sparkle.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
  10. Remove from the oven and let the shortbread saucers cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Tips

  • For an extra festive touch, lightly dust the cooled shortbread saucers with edible silver glitter or colored sugar crystals.
  • Store the shortbread in an airtight container at room temperature for up to one week.
  • You can add a pinch of ground cardamom or cinnamon to the dough for a subtle warm spice flavor that complements the evening ambiance.
